q1.answer_given: Standard AA/AAA batteries are cheapest but too bulky. Dynamo charging is dismissed as impractical. Solar charging adds cost and is fragile if dropped (the rendering also incorrectly states it works from ordinary room light, not just sunlight). Kinetic charging (favored) charges from everyday movement into a small watch-battery-sized cell with a long observed lifespan and low power draw since each use is brief. To conserve battery life, button backlighting (if used) should auto-off after five to ten seconds of inactivity.
